Container.Name: crowdsec-blocklist-import
Container.Overview:
Imports 28+ public threat-intelligence blocklists (IPsum, Spamhaus, Blocklist.de, Firehol, AbuseIPDB and more) into CrowdSec via LAPI, with deduplication, normalization and automatic refreshes.
Runs as a self-scheduling daemon: INTERVAL (default 3600 seconds) controls how often feeds are refreshed, so no User Scripts cron job is required. Set INTERVAL=0 for a single one-shot run (the container then exits).
Requires a reachable CrowdSec LAPI and a bouncer API key (create one on your CrowdSec host with: cscli bouncers add unraid-blocklist-import).
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: crowdsec blocklist threat intelligence security firewall ipsum spamhaus abuseipdb
Container.Requires: A running CrowdSec instance with its Local API reachable from this container, plus a bouncer API key.
Container.Changes: Initial Community Apps template. Tracks the latest multi-arch (amd64/arm64) image published from the source repository.

Config.Name: CrowdSec LAPI URL
Config.Description: URL of the CrowdSec Local API (scheme, host and port).

Config.Name: CrowdSec LAPI Key
Config.Description: Bouncer API key from 'cscli bouncers add'.

Config.Name: Run interval (seconds)
Config.Description: Seconds between import runs. 0 runs once and exits.

Config.Name: Decision duration
Config.Description: How long each imported ban lasts (e.g. 24h, 7d).

Config.Name: Opt-in feeds only
Config.Description: true: every feed starts disabled and is enabled per feed with ENABLE_* variables.

Config.Name: Allowlist
Config.Description: Comma-separated IPs/CIDRs that are never banned.

Config.Name: Custom blocklists
Config.Description: Comma-separated additional blocklist URLs to import.

Config.Name: Max decisions per run
Config.Description: Cap on decisions pushed per run. 0 = unlimited.

Config.Name: Batch size
Config.Description: Decisions per LAPI batch (memory vs. speed).

Config.Name: Anonymous telemetry
Config.Description: Anonymous usage ping; set false to disable.

Config.Name: Heartbeat interval
Config.Description: Seconds between machine heartbeats to LAPI. 0 disables.
